preconditions.description: K is the size of the permutation and is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: len(P) == K and all(1 <= x <= K for x in P)
preconditions.description: P is a permutation of K numbers, each between 1 and K.

preconditions.expression: len(matrix) == K and all(len(row) == K for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: Matrix is a KxK matrix where each element is either 'Y' or 'N'.

preconditions.expression: all(matrix[i][j] in ['Y', 'N'] for i in range(K) for j in range(K))
preconditions.description: Each element in the matrix is either 'Y' or 'N'.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == K and all(1 <= x <= K for x in return_value)
postconditions.description: The output is a permutation of K numbers, each between 1 and K.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value.count(x) == 1 for x in range(1, K+1))
postconditions.description: The output permutation has no duplicate elements.
The output permutation is the lexicographically smallest permutation that can be obtained from P.
